title: Rating History and Audit Trail
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want to query the rating history of an issuer for a date range so that I can audit rating changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: The history is queried by issuer_id, from_date and to_date (both inclusive) and returns all rating actions whose effective_date falls in the range.
Results are sorted by effective_date descending; actions with the same effective_date are sorted by recorded_at descending.
If from_date is after to_date the query is rejected with INVALID_DATE_RANGE. A range longer than 10 years is rejected with DATE_RANGE_TOO_LARGE.
An unknown issuer_id is rejected with ISSUER_NOT_FOUND. A known issuer with no actions in the range returns an empty list, not an error.
Each record includes action_id, action_type, agency, previous_rating, new_rating, notch_change, effective_date, analyst_id and recorded_at.
History records are immutable. A correction is recorded as a new action of type CORRECTION that references the original action_id; the original record remains visible.
